text:
nina: Heads-up from the authz postmortem: I created a compact follow-up tracker with top remediation items and proposed owners: https://tiny.redwood/authz-followup-compact. Please review and claim rows by EOD.

omar: I can pick up the audit-log ingestion fixes (row 2). Root cause looked like dropped events during peak due to backpressure on the ELK forwarder. ETA 7 days to add buffering + backpressure metrics.

leo: Ill own secrets rotation automation (row 5). Plan: add a rotation job and a forced re-issue for CI tokens flagged as long-lived. ETA 12 days. Will open PM ticket and attach test plan.

maria: Ill take role cleanup and permission scoping (row 3). Will produce a role->service map and propose a conservative prune list. ETA one sprint.

security-bot: Tasks created: PM-5508 (audit-ingest-hardening), PM-5509 (role-prune), PM-5510 (secrets-rotation). Links added to tracker.

nina: Two quick policy asks: (1) add compliance labels (gdpr/ccpa) and retention notes to each PM ticket; (2) flag legacy CI tokens separately as "legacy_migration" so we sequence safely.

omar: For PM-5508 I propose a short-term mitigation: add local disk buffering to the forwarder and increase send retries. Long-term: switch to a push-based ingest from gateways. I'll add the mitigation plan to PM-5508. Example conf snippet I'll add: ```yaml
forwarder:
  max_retries: 10
  local_buffer_mb: 512
```

leo: For secrets rotation: question  do we rotate KMS keys as part of PM-5510 or treat KMS key rotation separately? Rotating keys can require coordinated deploys.
maria: IMO separate ticket for KMS rotation unless its a direct blocker. Add KMS mapping to PM-5510 comments and we'll decide.

security-bot: Note: PM-5510 linked to vulnerability-board for any CA/rotation windows.

nina: Good call. Also, let's add a CI linter that blocks merges which create credentials w/o ttl or a TTL > 30d. Who can add that hook?
omar: I can add a lint rule and a pre-merge check. Snippet I'll add to PM-5508: `if config.token_ttl == null || config.token_ttl > 2592000: fail`.

leo: I'll start the rotation job prototype and open PR git.redwood/pr/1522. Will include zero-downtime key versioning in the runbook.
maria: Adding a "legacy_flag" column in the tracker and marked 8 entries as legacy. Those will get staged migrations rather than immediate rotation.

ops-bot: Weekly checkpoint scheduled for PM-5508 & PM-5510 every Mon 08:30 PT, invites to owners.
nina: Please add estimated MTTI/MTTR impact in the ticket so we can prioritize by customer risk. Also add a field for whether fix requires maintenance window.
omar: Added MTTI estimates to PM-5508 and provisional maintenance notes.

leo: Quick blocker: one legacy CI host stores tokens in plaintext; migration requires infra work. I will mark that as `blocking` in PM-5510 and raise in Thu sync.
maria: If something becomes customer-impacting, owners should add `blocking` label in tracker and ping #eng-oncall immediately per the runbook. I'll update the runbook doc with escalation steps.

nina: Sync scheduled Fri 10:00 PT to walk through blockers and finalize ETAs. Owners please update tracker and paste PR/ticket links in comments before the meeting. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
